tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Reading columns, the work area and briefing pages sit on it.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Ground one step back: the rail, table heads, wells behind a canvas. Never behind long text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: An object you can act on: cards, inputs, dialogs, menus. In light it separates by line and shadow, in dark by tone.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointer-over fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The current place or the selected row. One per list.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around quiet cards. Decoration only, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (buttons, inputs) and dashed draft outlines. Pair with a label; on its own it is below 3:1.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, sunken, card, hover and select.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, sunken and card: supporting lines, metadata, quiet labels.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg and card: counts, timestamps, placeholders. Smallest text that may use it is 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one primary action on a screen, the focus ring, links in running text, and the current step of a flow. Text and marks on bg, card and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: informational banners, the current step's ground.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark ink in the dark theme, because the accent lightens there.

tokens.name: today
tokens.usage: The Today icon in PMX, and the 'changed since last release' dot. A mark only, never text in light.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, delivered, healthy. Text and marks on bg, card and ok-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: waiting, stale, at risk. Text and marks on bg, card and warn-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text; the default banner ground.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failed, overdue, destructive. Text and marks on bg, card and bad-soft. Always with a word.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bad text.

tokens.name: ic-up
tokens.usage: The Upcoming icon in PMX's nav. Icon only.

tokens.name: ic-any
tokens.usage: The Anytime icon in PMX's nav. Icon only.

tokens.name: mac
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: something that lives or happens on this Mac. Text and strokes on mac-soft and bg.

tokens.name: mac-soft
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: node ground for this Mac.

tokens.name: claude
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams and proposals: something Claude does or suggests. Text and strokes on claude-soft and bg.

tokens.name: claude-soft
tokens.usage: Node ground for Claude; ground of a 'Proposed' chip.

tokens.name: linear
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: the team's tracker (Linear). Text and strokes on linear-soft and bg.

tokens.name: linear-soft
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: node ground for the tracker.

tokens.name: repo
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: the team's repository and files kept in it. Text and strokes on repo-soft and bg.

tokens.name: repo-soft
tokens.usage: Flow diagrams: node ground for the repository.

tokens.name: held
tokens.usage: Kept private, held back, or waiting at a human gate. Text and strokes on held-soft and bg.

tokens.name: held-soft
tokens.usage: Node ground for held; ground of a hold notice.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The veil behind a dialog or sheet. Darker in the dark theme than PMX's own value, which barely dims a dark page.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The thumb of a switch.

tokens.name: toast-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the button inside a toast, which sits on fg.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: t-title-1
styles.sample: Two things are ready to release
styles.usage: The answer line at the top of a screen. One per screen.

styles.name: t-title-2
styles.usage: A dialog title, or the heading of a major region.

styles.name: t-title-3
styles.usage: A card or section heading; a user's own heading while editing.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Sales sees three of the five sections.
styles.usage: The default. Rows, fields, running text in the work register.

styles.name: t-strong
styles.usage: The name of a thing inside a row or sentence.

styles.name: t-callout
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, the supporting line under a title, banner and toast text.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a row, counts, helper text. Usually fg-2.

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: Column heads and group labels. Sentence case, never all capitals. The floor: nothing is set smaller.

styles.name: b-display
styles.usage: The title on a briefing cover. One per page; drops to 34/38 under 600px.

styles.name: b-headline
styles.sample: Four themes carry the next six quarters
styles.usage: The opening line of a chapter inside a briefing.

styles.name: b-standfirst
styles.sample: By the end of FY28 every crew plans the job in Fieldbook first.
styles.usage: The one thing to remember, directly under the title. At most three lines.

styles.name: b-body
styles.sample: We do not build field hardware. We do not do the field work ourselves.
styles.usage: Running text a reader is meant to read, or that will be shown on a shared screen. Measure 60 to 68 characters.

styles.name: b-figure
styles.usage: A key figure. Tabular numerals. At most three on a screen.

styles.name: t-mono
styles.usage: A command the person types elsewhere, a path, an ID. Always with a Copy control when it is a command.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The unit. Icon to its label inside a chip; between a row's title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; inside chips and small buttons; between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a row or button (horizontal); between an icon and a title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gutter at phone width; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards; dialog padding; between groups in a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above a screen's answer line; between chapters of a briefing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a briefing cover; around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Bottom of a scrolling page, so the last row clears the edge.

tokens.name: r-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips with corners, focus rings.

tokens.name: r-m
tokens.usage: Rows on hover, banners, menus, small cards.

tokens.name: r-l
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, sheets, figures.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, counts, avatars, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised: a card that can be picked up or pressed. Rest state only when the card is the object of the screen.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Overlay: dialogs, sheets, menus, toasts, and a card while it is being dragged.

timing.note: One easing. Motion says where something went; it never decorates. All of it stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition.

tokens.name: dur-1
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus: feedback under the pointer.

tokens.name: dur-2
tokens.usage: A thing appears or leaves: menus, toasts, rows collapsing.

tokens.name: dur-3
tokens.usage: A surface arrives: dialogs, sheets, a step advancing on a track.

layout.note: Fixed measures. Everything else comes from the spacing scale.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The reading column: forms, lists, briefing text.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: A briefing's figures and boards; a settings page with a side list.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The icon rail of a studio-style shell.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: The labelled nav of a workspace-style shell.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of a default button, input and segmented control.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a small button or chip inside a dense row.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum target on a touch screen; applies under 768px.
